kcrash.cause: The Debian 6.30 technical-reference packaging requested debhelper-compat (= 14), while the Ubuntu 26.04 Resolute provider used by the clean build does not satisfy compatibility level 14. The same install-deps failure affected four independent nodes, so it is classified as a shared packaging-tooling/provider incompatibility rather than a node-owned package FAIL.

The package compiled and emitted binary packages, but the SupraLINUX-generated changelog used distribution UNRELEASED; the clean build's Lintian gate rejected this as unreleased-changes. The same generated-packaging defect affected both non-Python nodes.

knotifications.cause: The Debian 6.30 technical-reference packaging requested debhelper-compat (= 14), while the Ubuntu 26.04 Resolute provider used by the clean build does not satisfy compatibility level 14. The same install-deps failure affected four independent nodes, so it is classified as a shared packaging-tooling/provider incompatibility rather than a node-owned package FAIL.

KDE upstream Python bindings were preserved, but Shiboken ApiExtractor could not locate Clang's built-in include directory because the clean Resolute build environment lacked the default LLVM provider exposing /usr/bin/llvm-config; parsing then failed at C++ cstddef -> stddef.h. The same provider-discovery failure affected all three Python-binding nodes.

Shiboken now finds /usr/bin/llvm-config, but the clean Resolute environment has no versioned Clang resource-header directory under /usr/lib/llvm-21/lib/clang; ApiExtractor then fails at cstddef -> stddef.h. This is a shared provider-closure gap for the three KDE-upstream Python-binding nodes.

The package built, tested, passed Lintian, APT closure and the C++ consumer, but the generated Python binary package did not declare the PySide6 QtGui runtime provider required by the upstream binding typesystem; import KNotifications failed at PySide6.QtGui. This is a shared materializer runtime-dependency contract gap.

The package builds and tests PASS, but Debian's pinned copyright metadata declares two non-DFSG test fixtures in Files-Excluded while the raw KDE authority tarball still contains them. Lintian correctly rejects source-ships-excluded-file. SupraLINUX needs a verified distribution repack, not a suppressed Lintian error.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: All four clean builds converged on unsatisfied debhelper-compat (= 14) before compilation.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Rematerialize the SupraLINUX package trees with an explicit Ubuntu Resolute packaging-tooling adaptation to debhelper compatibility level 13, without changing the KDE upstream feature profile, then repeat clean builds.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: The campaign pinned libkf6i18n-data as 3df2300d5aca640c8968859367ac3cd606a31e87e875ca207a71eeda6d03f45a, while retained KI18n artifact 10553916882 contains 3df2300d5aca640c8968859367ac3cd606a31a87e875ca207a71eeda6d03f45a.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Correct the campaign pin to the SHA-256 verified from the retained artifact before the next clean-build campaign.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: The deterministic materializer generated a top changelog entry with distribution UNRELEASED. Both nodes compiled and produced .deb files, then Lintian rejected unreleased-changes.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Generate the SupraLINUX changelog entry for the Ubuntu 26.04 base target as resolute and rematerialize before rebuilding.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: Shiboken ApiExtractor warned that it could not locate Clang's built-in include directory via LLVM_INSTALL_DIR, CLANG_INSTALL_DIR or llvm-config; the environment lacked the default llvm provider and parsing failed at /usr/include/c++/15/cstddef -> stddef.h.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Add Ubuntu Resolute llvm-dev as a build-tool provider for Python-binding package trees so /usr/bin/llvm-config and the matching LLVM 21 development surface are available, without changing KDE's BUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS=ON profile.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: llvm-config is now present, but Shiboken reports no subdirectories under /usr/lib/llvm-21/lib/clang and cannot find stddef.h.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Extend the Resolute Shiboken provider closure with libclang-common-21-dev and verify the Clang 21 builtin resource header before package promotion.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: Debian copyright Files-Excluded names autotests/rss2/stefandecker.org.xml and .expected, but the raw KDE authority orig still ships both; Lintian emits source-ships-excluded-file.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Verify the Debian repacked orig differs from KDE authority only by declared Files-Excluded, then use that repack as distribution source artifact while retaining KDE as source/version authority.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: The generated Python binary packages relied on shlibs/python substvars but did not declare the PySide6 module packages loaded by KDE upstream binding typesystems.
infrastructure_incidents.remediation: Encode the upstream typesystem-to-Resolute-provider mapping in the package contract and generated Python Depends. KNotifications -> python3-pyside6.qtgui, KUnitConversion -> python3-pyside6.qtcore, KStatusNotifierItem -> python3-pyside6.qtwidgets (which pulls QtGui and QtCore on Resolute).

note: Crossing the sbuild boundary records a real execution. Canonical FAIL still requires a node-owned root cause; shared infrastructure/provider failures remain INFRA with package_state_effect=none. Pre-sbuild failures are infrastructure incidents, not real package attempts.
